The Notes are senior unsecured obligations of the Company and rank pari passu with all existing and future
senior debt and senior to all existing and future subordinated indebtedness of the Company. The indenture under
which the Notes were issued contains covenants and restrictions which limit among other things, the following:
the incurrence of indebtedness, payment of dividends and certain distributions, sale of assets, change in control,
mergers and consolidations and the incurrence of liens.
